services.desc: Looking for where to stay near Glacier National Park? Look no further! Filled with scenic views, comfy cabin decor, and modern amenities, this West Glacier vacation rental is an ideal home base for outdoorsy families seeking easy access to the park! Get away from the bustle of city life and reconnect with nature from the comfort of this 4-bed, 3-bath home in picturesque West Glacier. The entrance to Glacier National Park is a short 1-mile bike ride from this vacation rental’s front door. It's all about the hiking here, and the shuttle to access it all is right in Apgar.
